title: Pocket Mobile App On-Device QA & Ledger Reconciliation
summary: Ran a full on-device QA pass on the Pocket Android app (version 1.0.117) across a Pixel 6a dev phone, verifying launch, streaming chat, web search, settings reachability, and crypto/permission regressions with zero failures and 16 evidence artifacts. Reconciled a stranded prior QA run whose 14 evidence files were left untracked with no ledger entry, and corrected stale feature notes in the project ledger against the shipped build. One genuine gap remains: protocol-error (4xx/5xx) auto-detection in the streaming client.

title: LLM Gateway Auto-Vision Routing, k3s Pressure Relief & Service Diagnostics
summary: Upgraded the LLM gateway 'auto' metamodel to transparently route image-bearing requests to auto-vision (commit pushed and deployed via staged blue/green swap). Resolved a control-plane resource-pressure incident on the k3s cluster by relieving disk pressure (93% to 52%) and removing 147 orphaned failed pods, tracing the root cause to a resource-pressure feedback loop plus cron churn. Also diagnosed the public blog/dashboard site serving a stale deployment due to an Azure SWA custom-domain binding to an older app (fix identified, pending approval) and reviewed the arewefucked status dashboard, identifying an inverted thermometer marker scale (one-line fix) and a provider-grouping gap in incident chatter.

title: Local LLM Inference Stack on Homelab GPU & Pocket App QA
summary: Installed Ollama 0.40.16 on the homelab server with Vulkan acceleration on the AMD GPU (embeddings verified via /api/embed), and built llama.cpp from source with the Vulkan backend to provide a combined embedding + reranking server (llama-server binary linked successfully). Also ran on-device QA and independent CI/store verification for the Pocket Android app (v1.0.117 build confirmed published).

title: Homelab Dashboard Enhancements, LLM Gateway Auto-Vision & Service Audit
summary: Shipped wakeable-service and cron-findings widgets plus a full service audit/deprecation plan to the homelab dashboard (CI green), rebuilt and validated the LLM gateway auto-vision meta-model end-to-end with test images, and fixed an email MCP shadowing bug restoring all email tools. Also added an OpenCode Go usage monitor cron, removed obsolete profile-management crons, researched incremental Obsidian/Quartz rebuilds, and ran on-device Pocket app QA (vc115/vc117) with CI verification.

title: Pocket Config Endpoint, Internal CA & Webview PiP; OOB Session Cursor Fix
summary: Built and verified a pocket-cfg Go endpoint (Argon2id phrase-gated config delivery with rate limiting) plus an internal root CA with wildcard cert and CA download button in the app store, with CI green on both the Go and Android builds. Shipped rounded-corner webview picture-in-picture with zoom-out and tap-to-fullscreen for the Pocket app, verified on-device. Fixed a frozen cursor in the out-of-band session summary cron that had been re-reporting ~349 stale sessions each run.

title: Email-Sync DMARC-Gated Trusted Sender & Pocket On-Device QA
summary: Built and end-to-end verified a DMARC-gated trusted-sender capability for the email-sync service: Go code parses Cloudflare's Authentication-Results header and fail-closes on spoofed senders, with a new trusted-commands rule firing Rook sessions only for verified senders. Deployed via CI image build and Flux, recovered from a node memory-pressure incident during rollout, and re-verified the gate on the final pod. Separately ran on-device QA across Pocket Android builds vc91 and vc98 (identity, launch, streaming, web search, web_render).

title: Pocket Android App: Web Render & Web Fetch Verification, Telemetry QA
summary: Exercised the web_render feature on-device (vc91 build), confirming WebView factory loading and stream completion across two chat turns. Verified web_fetch end-to-end (200 OK, 593K chars) and tested the OTEL telemetry client path against the cluster endpoint. Ran additional on-device QA spot-checks covering identity, launch, hello streaming, web search, and settings UI reachability; all passed. Committed evidence and ledger updates across multiple PM cycles.

title: Pocket Android App: On-Device QA Verification & Evidence Ledger
summary: Ran on-device QA spot-checks on the Pocket Android app (vc91 build), verifying device identity, launch stability, hello streaming (200 OK, 8 data lines), and permission/dialog handling. Captured 28 evidence artifacts (screenshots and logs) and committed the run entry to the project ledger. CI, app store, and device all confirmed in sync with repo HEAD; no code changes required this cycle.

title: Rook Push Notification System & Pocket Web Extraction
summary: Built and end-to-end verified a push notification pipeline: a LAN-only message broker deployed in the cluster, a notify_push tool exposed through the homelab MCP server, and a signed Android app that receives pushes and opens Discord deep links on tap. Separately, shipped granular web extraction for the Pocket Android app with a picture-in-picture WebView overlay and verified the build on a test device.

title: Homelab MCP Email Send Tool & Cron/Obsidian Pipeline Fixes
summary: Added an email_send tool to the homelab MCP service with SMTP delivery, recipient blacklist, threading support, HTML bodies, and an agent-origin identity check. Ported email triage into the Obsidian vault with skip-CI commits and a scheduled rebuild, and fixed the out-of-band session summary cron to use a since-last-successful-report cursor so it stops re-reporting the same sessions.

title: Pocket Android App: Web Search Backend Rewrite & Infra Docs Update
summary: Replaced the WebView-based web search in the Pocket Android app with an OkHttp DuckDuckGo HTML backend after discovering onPageFinished never fired in the rendering environment, and fixed a NetworkOnMainThreadException by moving tool execution to Dispatchers.IO. Shipped builds vc80 and vc84 with full on-device QA verification of streaming, web search, and web fetch. Also ran the nightly docs coverage audit, documenting the Obsidian vault viewer, Pocket web_search/web_fetch tools, an LLM gateway auto-vision meta-model, and an email-sync trigger prompt fix.

title: Pocket App QA, LLM Gateway Vision Model & Context Metadata
summary: Ran on-device QA across multiple Pocket Android builds, surfacing a backend streaming failure (tool-call ID resolution) that blocked chat and web-search validation. Implemented and pushed an auto-vision meta-model plus a dedicated image-reader profile in the LLM gateway, and prepared context-window metadata exposure so the agent can auto-detect model limits (both awaiting deploy). Fixed a container build syntax error and redeployed the Quartz-based notes-vault static site.

title: Git-Backed Notes Vault & Static Publishing Pipeline
summary: Migrated a personal notes vault from ad-hoc sync to a git-backed repository and implemented an automated static-site publishing pipeline. Added a containerized build that renders Markdown content into a static site, plus CI and cluster deployment manifests for on-demand, wakeable serving in the homelab cluster behind access controls.

title: Pocket Remote Agents, Telemetry & Seeded Builds; K3s Wake-Health Watchdog
summary: Extended the Pocket Android app with a generic remote-agent registry streaming over the Hermes gateway, opt-in permission toggles, an OTEL telemetry pipeline, a persistent memory store, and seeded (config-preloaded) builds via CI while keeping public builds secret-free. Also shipped a k3s wake-health watchdog (runtime script, scheduled checks, and CI manifest validation) that detects stuck wakes, stale endpoints, and crash-looping pods. CI runs green across the affected repos.

title: Pocket @rook Subagent Support & Gateway Streaming Fix
summary: Added native @rook subagent support to the Pocket Android app using the Hermes gateway OpenAI Responses endpoint, with a new streaming RookClient. Patched the gateway streaming path to emit standard OpenAI tool_calls deltas so tool progress renders correctly in the app. Fixed Android permissions and runtime request flow, sandboxed /tmp inside the proot rootfs, added proot provisioning with exec fallback, and corrected the health-check path. Diagnosed a DNS resolution issue where Android Private DNS bypasses the homelab resolver.

title: Pocket App Crash Fix & Bambu 3MF Slicer Reverse Engineering
summary: Fixed a crash in the Pocket Android app caused by a missing VIBRATE permission triggered by haptic feedback, corrected CI gradle cache volume naming, and added diagnostic logging to investigate a chat streaming hang. Reverse-engineered Bambu Studio's 3MF format for a multi-material stacked-print generator, documenting per-part extruder-based filament assignment, prime tower flush behavior, and measured coplanar interface feature-drop. Also verified a WiFi SSID is already broadcasting on both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands across both access points.

title: K3s Cluster Memory Pressure Investigation
summary: Investigated memory pressure across the k3s cluster, collecting concrete metrics (PSI, free, kubectl top, zram/zswap state, OOM and eviction history) on the control-plane and worker nodes. Found the control-plane node actively thrashing under earlyoom kills, a worker node near full Kubernetes memory allocation, and mixed swap/compression setups across nodes (zram on one, zswap on another, none elsewhere). Delivered a per-node pressure and top-consumer breakdown to guide follow-up tuning.

title: OOB Session Summary Pipeline — LLM-Driven Summaries
summary: Rewrote the out-of-band session summary script to gather non-cron, non-channel sessions with per-session digests instead of posting a mechanical dump. Converted the cron job from script-only to an LLM agent that produces real 1-2 sentence summaries and posts them to the forum. Verified end-to-end covering 47 sessions; docs and forum overrides committed and pushed.

title: OOB Session Automation & Hermes Patch Durability
summary: Built an automated out-of-band session summary pipeline that posts hourly summaries to a Discord forum. Made a local Hermes agent code fix durable across upgrades via an idempotent patch script, git hooks, and a cron safety net; also fixed an approvals configuration gap blocking critical commands.

title: LLM Gateway Model Ranking Page Update
summary: Updated the internal LLM gateway root page to serve current model rankings for each meta-model (auto, free). Rankings now expose composite scores and are ordered by tier, observed evidence, score, then name. Page refreshes every 3 seconds.

title: Secrets Drop Box, Wake-on-Connect Gatekeeper & Agent Tool Intent
summary: Deployed a new Secrets Drop Box service for out-of-band credential ingestion over Cloudflare Access, backed by native Kubernetes Secrets with a CLI sanitize tool that redacts known secret values from text. Rolled out a label-driven transient gatekeeper that scales 23 services to zero on idle and auto-wakes them on first request, with multi-host/per-port routing and network policies. Added a synthetic _intent parameter to every agent tool call, intercepted and stripped before MCP forwarding, and rendered alongside tool calls in Discord.

title: 3D Print Tooling: Interactive G-code Previewer & 3MF Library, Hermes Go Rewrite Milestone
summary: Shipped an interactive 3D G-code previewer that animates toolpaths layer-by-layer during playback with tool-change indicators, orbit controls, build-plate rendering, and merged solid layer meshes for mobile-friendly performance. Launched a color-rendered 3MF file library, and fixed a browser GPU crash by serializing WebGL thumbnail rendering with immediate context disposal; also revived a stalled CI runner and worked around a shared pipeline docker-socket mount bug to unblock builds. Landed the first working milestone of a Go rewrite of the Hermes agent core (chat loop + Discord adapter) with all checks green.

title: Attachment Resolver Preview Page, Gateway Memory Hardening & Hermes Go Rewrite Scope
summary: Added an HTML preview page with download button to the Discord attachment resolver (Go service, shipped via Gitea CI). Resolved a 502 outage on the attachment resolver by reducing Hermes gateway memory limits and restored session resumption after a DNS failure. Scoped a Go rewrite of the Hermes core loop and Discord adapter into a 35-week milestone plan using ephemeral Python tool workers.

title: Rayobrowse Session Store — Keyed Persistent Browser Sessions
summary: Implemented a Go-based keyed, persistent browser-session store for the rayobrowse CDP browser, deployed to k3s with Longhorn-backed PVC storage. Proved end-to-end session restoration — an authenticated login was reopened from a fresh browser using restored cookies and localStorage. Discovered and documented three real bugs (localStorage capture format mismatch, wrong cookie CDP commands, browser reaping mid-session) and stored platform credentials in the KDBX vault.

title: Discord Attachment Resolver Deploy & Hermes Source Migration to Gitea
summary: Shipped the attachment resolver service — a Go-based Discord attachment URL resolver with HMAC-signed links, deployed via Gitea Actions CI to k3s with release artifacts and a smoke-tested binary. Migrated the Hermes Agent source tree from GitHub to a self-hosted Gitea instance with host-scoped credential helper and a fork-sync update path. Completed an independent security audit of the SWA dashboard Functions API confirming current responses are clean, while disclosing a historical pre-redaction deployment window and an unauthorized production commit that fixed a category-slug XSS sink.

title: STL Web Previewer Deploy & Hermes Profiles k3s Migration
summary: Built and deployed an interactive STL web previewer service (Flask + Three.js) through the full Gitea-to-CI-to-k3s pipeline, accepting STL uploads and serving viewable links. Migrated the hermes-profiles management app from a host systemd service to a k3s pod with Traefik ingress, hostPath volumes, and network policy. Also resolved Gitea Actions CI failures including missing registry push token scopes and fixed camera-service IngressRoute path routing conflicts.

title: Headless Multi-Color Slicer
summary: Started a headless CLI pipeline for multi-color (AMS) slicing on the Bambu P1S — extracting Bambu Studio's extruder-mapping machinery and driving OrcaSlicer headless from generated OpenSCAD STLs. Open problem: CLI mode forces single-extruder output from the P1S profile.

title: Discord Forum Tooling Migration & Gateway Patch
summary: Implemented declarative per-forum tooling context via Gitea-hosted YAML with 20 forum overrides, extended ChannelOverride with toolsets/skills/context/docs fields, and patched the gateway for toolset resolution and context injection with a 15-minute mirror cron. Also added a 48-hour purge cron for the Discord attachments channel and improved sidecar filenames to use readable tool-kind labels.

title: Azure SWA Dashboard Deploy
summary: Rewrote the personal blog as a homelab dashboard on Azure Static Web Apps with API proxy functions and real-time cluster monitoring.

title: Multi-Agent Content Pipeline
summary: Built a pipeline where RSS feeds are discovered, claim-ordered by AI agents, written in parallel, and auto-published after QA review.
